podcast.body: This 18-track, 73-minute album was released on February 10, 1992. Richie Edwards, despite being a prominent member, did not play a single note on the record, fulfilling other roles within the band. The band signed with Columbia Records just six days after Richie's infamous "for real" self-mutilation incident. "It was released on February 10th, 1992, and Richie didn't play a single note on the record, but that was okay because he had other roles to perform."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Uncharted "Sneak Peak" - Episode 9: The Disappearance of Richey Edwards
